clinician.trajectory_summary: A 73-year-old female with a history of pelvic radiotherapy and bilateral ureteric strictures presented with severe haematuria, hypotension, and tachycardia. Initial CTA showed the ureter inseparable from the external and ectatic internal iliac arteries but no active extravasation. A subsequent catheter angiogram confirmed active bleeding from the right internal iliac artery into the distal ureter, consistent with an arterio-ureteral fistula (AUF). The patient underwent successful embolization of the fistula.

The arterio-ureteral fistula was successfully managed with embolization.
